interaction_details: Nibima extracts contain alkaloids that bind to dietary iron minerals in the digestive tract, significantly reducing iron absorption in pregnant women.
cultural_advice_twi: Sɛ worenom Nibima a, ntwɛn bɛyɛ dɔnhwerew mmienu (2 hours) ansa na wanom wo dadeɛ nnuru (Iron supplement) no na amma w'abobow enni nkɔnim.
cultural_advice_english: If taking Nibima herbal tea, wait at least 2 hours before taking your prenatal Iron supplements to ensure full absorption and prevent anemia.

interaction_details: Both Taabea mixture and high doses of paracetamol are metabolized by liver enzymes (CYP450). Concomitant high-dose usage can increase metabolic burden on the liver.
cultural_advice_twi: Kɔsi sɛ wo dɔkta bekyerɛ wo kwan no, mmonom Taabea ne Paracetamol pii bere koro mu na amma w'abrabo enni hawm.
cultural_advice_english: Avoid taking high doses of Taabea Bitters and Paracetamol at the exact same time to prevent liver strain.

interaction_details: Moringa leaves possess natural blood pressure-lowering properties. Combining large quantities with prescribed blood pressure medication may cause mild hypotension (dizziness).
cultural_advice_twi: Moringa boa ma mogya mmoroso te ase. Sɛ worenom mogya mmoroso duru a, hwɛ yie na wo mogya ammotɔ ampa.
cultural_advice_english: Moringa naturally lowers blood pressure. Monitor your vitals closely if taking it along with prescribed blood pressure medicine.

interaction_details: High concentration Neem tea extracts have documented anti-fertility and uterine stimulation effects. Highly contraindicated during early pregnancy.
cultural_advice_twi: Nyinsɛn bere a edi kan mu no, mmonom Neem nsuo koraa. Etumi ma emuyinsɛn gu dɔteɛ mu.
cultural_advice_english: Avoid Neem leaf tea completely during pregnancy, especially in the first trimester, as it can cause uterine contractions.

interaction_details: Adding heavy milk or dairy products to Hausa Koko creates calcium-drug chelates with fluoroquinolone or tetracycline antibiotics, reducing antibiotic efficacy by up to 50%.
cultural_advice_twi: Sɛ worenom antibiotic nnuru a, mde nufusuo pii mefra Hausa Koko no bere a worenom aduru no.
cultural_advice_english: When prescribed antibiotics, avoid adding heavy milk or condensed milk to Hausa Koko at the same time as taking your dose.

interaction_details: Vitamin C in lemon and citrus enhances non-heme iron absorption in the gut. Safe and beneficial for pregnant women.
cultural_advice_twi: Ginger ne Lemur nsuo papabi wɔ nyinsɛn mu. Yɛboa ma wo ho yɛ den na ɛma Iron nso yɛ adwuma yie.
cultural_advice_english: Ginger and Lemon water is safe and Vitamin C in lemon actually enhances your body's absorption of iron supplements.
